blurb: Little Dell Recreation Area offers picnic sites, two boat launches for non-motorized boats, and fishing with specific restrictions. The area is managed to preserve water quality and provide a natural habitat near Salt Lake Valley. The entrance gate is open daily from 8:00 a.m. to dusk from Memorial Day weekend to October 1, with pedestrian access year-round.

extraNote: No fires, charcoal barbecues, or Dutch ovens allowed; only propane stoves for cooking · No motorized boats, no electric motors, no paddle boards, no kayak rolling · Boats must be clean before entering; cleaning debris in reservoir prohibited · All watercraft must stay 200 yards away from the dam · Fishing allowed with artificial flies and lures only; clean waders required; no fish cleaning on site; all cutthroat trout must be released immediately · No dogs allowed in the protected watershed area · Entrance gate at Little Dell Recreation Area, accessed via State Highway 65 north of I-80 exit 134 · Memorial Day weekend to October 1 (gate open); pedestrian access year-round
